newsitem.title: ROMANIA: RADIO ROMANIA AFTERNOON HEADLINES AT 4 PM.
newsitem.headline: RADIO ROMANIA AFTERNOON HEADLINES AT 4 PM.

text.p: * Emil Constantinescu, Democratic Convention candidate for the November 3 predidential polls, met pensionaires' representatives and presented "contract with Romania".
* Social Democratic Union presidential candidate Petre Roman started electoral visit to Olt county.
* Romanian President Ion Iliescu met Zdenek Kessler, president of the Czech Constitutional Court. Kessler is on an official visit to Romania.
* City-hall approved resignation of George Padure, mayor of Bucharest's first district. The government has to set date for elections within next 30 days. --Bucharest Newsroom 40-1 3120264
